scope: keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, browser speech fallback, touch targets, and serious/critical accessibility checks

assertions: visible focus indicator is at least 2 CSS px
Escape closes the voice settings dialog
reduced-motion disables automatic scroll animation and reduces transition duration to at most 1 ms
browser speech fallback supports pause, resume, stop, replay, rapid repeated play, case-switch cancellation, and refresh reset

excludedNonProductNetworkEvents.kind: development HMR hot-update request aborted during navigation

excludedInvalidRuns.reason: The initial axe probe omitted the existing safe API fixture and produced local API 404 noise; the QA-only probe was corrected and the complete four-viewport matrix was rerun.

notes: Automated viewport results do not constitute real-device soft-keyboard, dynamic browser chrome, safe-area, screen-reader, or physical touch validation.
No business code, data, medical facts, or approval state were changed.
